subject: 明代北方府城：山庄大院（原创扩展）；具体构件断代（待考）。
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated reusable building sprite for tianshu default building-map, Ming dynasty northern Chinese prefectural city (Beijing/Datong/Xian regional vocabulary), anonymous original period-inspired design, not a measured heritage reconstruction. Input image is STYLE reference only: match its restrained realistic material detail, fine grey clay roof tiles, weathered masonry and natural matte wood, and same detail density. Change architecture to Ming north as specified. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric ground projection, camera yaw45 elevation30, east axis down-right slope +0.5 and north up-right slope -0.5; parallel ground edges, vertical posts, no perspective convergence. South entrance on screen lower-left edge. Complete building on thin rectangular ground-contact footprint with readable left, front, right corners, footprint axis ratio as specified, no thick pedestal, no soil island. Neutral soft light from SCREEN UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow only toward lower-right. TRUE transparent RGBA background and generous blank alpha0 margins all four sides; no skyline, no surrounding scenery. No people, writing, Chinese pseudo-glyphs, text, plaques, signs, banners, watermark, grid, modern fittings, plastic render, cartoon, ink wash, oversaturation, dense lanterns, white halo or baked checkerboard. Only building and its own footprint; include all eaves and base corners uncropped. Asset ID bld_kit_ming_north_manor. Footprint 16 metres east-west by 13 metres north-south. A wealthy merchant clan compound / huiguan-compatible manor module: axial hall and two modest hard-gabled side wings surrounding a rectangular grey-brick courtyard, high grey walls, plain timber lattice windows and stout entry gate. Taller main ridge than simple houses but no imperial yellow roof, no lavish Qing painting or Suzhou garden. Restrained small stone entry plinth, material realism. The reference must NOT dictate roof silhouette: use proper NORTH CHINESE YINGSHAN hard-gabled roofs, flush grey-brick triangular gable walls rising to ridge at both ends, NO overhanging eaves at the gable end, no upward-curled corner tips. Flat thin foundation.
